questions.stem: A house was bought for $£200,\!000$ and sold for $£230,\!000$. What is the percentage profit?
$£500$ is invested at $3\%$ compound interest per year. What is the value after $2$ years?
questions.explanation: After year 1: $500 \times 1.03 = £515$. After year 2: $515 \times 1.03 = £530.45$. Using the formula: $500 \times 1.03^2 = 500 \times 1.0609 = £530.45$.

questions.stem: After a $20\%$ increase, a price is $£60$. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: A $20\%$ increase means the new price is $120\%$ of the original. So original $= \frac{60}{1.20} = £50$.
